description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that provides functionality to add, remove, and manage display panels within the CodeMirror editor instance.

classes.name: Panel
classes.description: Represents a display panel within the CodeMirror editor, with methods to clear and detect changes.

methods.name: addPanel
methods.description: Adds a new panel to the CodeMirror editor with specified options and manages its placement.

methods.name: Panel.prototype.clear
methods.description: Removes the panel from the editor and updates the layout accordingly.

methods.name: Panel.prototype.changed
methods.description: Updates the panel's height based on its DOM element and readjusts the editor size.
